bff-cluster.//HealthCheck: 020-timeouts-retry-circuit-breaker (research.md Decision 3): circuit-breaker equivalent for the reverse-proxy hop, since retrying an arbitrary forwarded method here would risk duplicating a non-idempotent request (spec FR-006). AvailableDestinationsPolicy is explicit: YARP's own default ('HealthyOrPanic') falls back to treating every destination as available when none are healthy, which is the right choice for a cluster with several destinations but defeats the point of a circuit breaker for this cluster's single destination — 'HealthyAndUnknown' is the policy that actually fails fast (503) instead of still attempting a connection it already knows will fail.
